fields.title-post: 8 digital canteen offerings for the foodservice industry
fields.rt-blog-html:
In an age of digitalization and ever-changing working patterns, corporate meal delivery is no longer simply a luxury, but a necessity. By enabling employees to save time and enjoy a varied, high-quality diet, without having to leave their place of work. This option has established itself as an optimal solution for many companies concerned with the well-being of their teams. 

In this Innovorder guide, we explore 8 of the most popular digital canteen offerings. From Frichti and Popchef to Deliveroo and Foodles, let's dive into a world of food that combines practicality and modernity!

‍

1. Frichti 

Since its launch in 2015, Frichti has rapidly positioned itself as a key player in the meal delivery market thanks to its unique approach. Combining the demands of a home-cooked meal with the efficiency of a modern delivery service, Frichti meets the growing demand from professionals looking to combine productivity at work with quality food.

One of Frichti's greatest strengths lies in its ability to tailor its offer to the needs of businesses. In addition to guaranteeing the freshness and quality of its dishes, Frichti offers an ergonomic digital platform that makes it easy to place and track orders, even for large quantities. This operational efficiency is particularly advantageous for companies wishing to organize hassle-free business meals, team lunches or even in-house events!

‍

2. Foodcheri

Founded in 2015, Foodcheri has positioned itself as a healthy alternative to fast food options. Offering dishes prepared by chefs, the company combines gourmet with speed, particularly with click and collect lunches.

Foodcheri offers companies a group ordering service, suitable for team meals and business events. Their varied menu ensures that there's something for everyone.

👉 Further information: The impact of teleworking on company canteens

‍

3. Foodles

Foodles is revolutionizing the concept of the canteen by offering a digital canteen, where connected fridges are regularly stocked with fresh dishes. The company is strongly committed to a more responsible canteen.

With their connected fridge system, employees can choose their meal and pay via an app, making meal management simple and efficient for companies.

Companies like Dailymotion have integrated Foodles to meet the needs of their employees, underlining the efficiency of the service.

👉 To find out more: The 2.0 digital canteen for your lunch break

‍

4. Popchef

Similar to Foodles, Popchef also offers a digital canteen, but relies on collaborations with renowned chefs to create its menus.

Popchef, with its focus on gastronomy, offers a high-end culinary experience while retaining the practicality of connected fridges.

5. Deliveroo

Since its launch in 2013 in London, Deliveroo has expanded internationally, becoming one of the leading meal delivery platforms.

With Deliveroo for Business, the company offers a dedicated solution for professionals, enabling simplified ordering, centralized invoicing and customized offers for businesses.

In particular, Deliveroo has forged partnerships with major chains such as Starbucks and Burger King, making it easier for companies to place volume orders.

‍

6. HoppLunch

HoppLunch, with its focus on balanced, sustainable nutrition, offers meals prepared with local, seasonal produce.

HoppLunch offers an eco-friendly option for companies concerned about their carbon footprint. Their menu changes regularly, reflecting the seasonality of products.

‍

7. Uber eats

Part of the giant Uber in 2014, UberEats has gradually expanded its offering to meet the needs of professionals.

UberEats for business offers easy expense management, scheduled ordering and fast delivery, suitable for business lunches.

‍

8. Exki

Exki, founded in 2001, favors natural, fresh ingredients, with a focus on ecology, for healthy, sustainable cooking.

Recognizing the importance of corporate demand, Exki offers delivery solutions tailored to the needs of businesses, while maintaining its commitment to healthy eating.

‍

In an ever-changing professional world, the well-being of employees takes center stage. And what better way to promote their well-being than with a healthy, varied diet tailored to their needs? Corporate meal delivery services have responded brilliantly to this demand. From the homemade Frichti to the innovative digital canteens of Foodles and Popchef, not to mention the recognized efficiency of Deliveroo and UberEats, there are many options to suit every corporate need.
